Bring Hailsham’s roads back to a their former glory, “My aim is to get Hailsham streets and roads back to their former glory with the help and support of the residents of the town. I really believe that this is easily fulfillable. I hope, the end result for Hailsham will be a happy and safe place to live as far as the community and roads go., I am wanting to start a petition because the roads in and around hailsham are a disgrace!. myself and more than 50% of residents of the town are no where near happy with our town 

I ride a motorcycle myself and this town is no way safe for me anymore let alone all the other road users

Pay Carers an allowance equivalent to a fulltime job at the National Living wage, Paying unpaid carers would safeguard those requiring care making it a financially viable option for friends and family to look after those they love, Reducing pressure on 999 services and the NHS. Saving vast amounts of money per person. The carer who provides continuity in care is often forgotten, To address the social care crisis and in part solve it. Building a strong foundation..
Changing millions of lives. Boosting local economies. Safeguarding the vulnerable, Elderly and Disabled. Reducing pressure on our Emergency Services and NHS.

Make it compulsory for all leisure centres to carry out checks under Sarah's law, I am a childrens rights campaigner and think all leisure centres should have to carry out checks under Sarah's law on all membership applications to ensure the safety of all children using the facilities.
As schools often use these complexes., Give parents the confidence and security that their children are safe while using these facilities whether with family or the school.

Remove the East Anglia franchise from the Greater Anglia company, For many years now I have found the service provided to be inadequate and overpriced, yet further increases this year and yet still hardly any weekend service and any service that does run during peak hours is often delayed. , We would like government to remove the franchise from Greater Anglia just like with Northern Rail.

Weekend Engineering works means I find it hard to get a train at weekends, more than a half of the year it seems there are no trains available at weekends. Despite these works the service has no improvement and the cost has gone up considerably, we have seen landslides cancel services and now speed restrictions cancel peak hour trains due the track no being fit for purpose. The environmental impact is now being hit as I know of many individuals that are returning to their cars instead of the train.

End 'other children a paying parent supports' deductions to Child Maintenance., The CMS purports to exist to assist separated parents. Why then does it take financial support away from the child(ren) that are in need of it? Parentage is assumed if the 'paying parent' meets certain criteria - surely, then, these criteria should be applied when considering these deductions?, Family Law - namely the Children Act 1989 - stipulates that the Court's paramount consideration shall lie with the welfare of the child. Is financial support not directly linked to the child's welfare? Any single parent can tell you that even Child Maintenance payments often do not come close to providing the standard of life that you hope for your child. Clothes, shoes, books/toys, school trips, uniforms, school donations, holidays - the list of financial demands as a single parent are endless!

Introduce Mandatory Ethnicity Pay Gap Reporting, Much like the existing mandatory requirement for employers with 250 or more employees must publish their gender pay gap.  We call upon the government to introduce the ethnicity pay gap reporting. To shine a light on race / ethnicity based inequality in the workplace so that they can be addressed., Currently there is a lack of data available in gauging the ethnicity pay gap in the workplace.  Introducing these measures will allow employers to be held accountable in closing the gap where there is disparity.  In order to achieve a fairer workplace publishing this data is one of the next steps to knowing how extensive the issues are  from a race and ethnicity perspective and not just through the lens of gender.

Highway Code Rules 163 and 215 to be made law. Pass horses wide and slow. , I am calling on the Secretary of State for Transport to make the following rules in the Highway Code actual laws:
Section 163 - Overtake only when it is safe and legal to do so.
Section 215 - Horse riders and horse-drawn vehicles pass wide and slow max 15mph and abide to our stop slow, signal, The British Horse Society statistics show that from November 2010 to March 2019 of the 3,737 incidents reported to them there was 315 horses killed and 43 humans killed on our roads. (NB: These are only incidents reported directly to the BHS.)

The BHS recommends that vehicles should not pass horses at more than 15mph and no closer than a car width.

There have been far too many incidents on the road including deaths both equine and human. Many of these deaths are the result of drivers driving at an inappropriate speed and too closely. The number of prosecutions at court does not reflect the seriousness of driving in such a manner.

Making rules 163 and 215 of the highway code law would give more power to the police and the courts to prosecute in these cases

The Legalisation of Euthanasia in the UK, Allow terminally ill individuals the choice of when they end their suffering. 

Of course, Euthanasia needs to be regulated, but allow the people to choose how or when they pass away. 

If an individual has a condition that will lead to a painful drawn out death give them the choice., Currently too many people endure suffering in their last few weeks or months of living and go with little dignity. Instead both they and their loved ones must ride out weeks of distress and pain. 

Allowing terminally ill individuals to choose to cut life short by a matter of days or weeks will mean they have the final say on how they should pass away and avoid unnecessary suffering.

Euthanasia gives those who are terminally ill comfort in knowing the end is something not to be feared.

Stop the migration of people to Universal Credit, As a disabled person I’m really scared about Universal Credit (UC) as there is evidence it can make disabled people worse off., It’s hard enough to go through PIP & ESA assessments. I feel that UC is going to make it harder for us. So I would like the government to pause or cancel the planned migration.
 
The reason why I want to government to cancel the planned migration is I believe it would make peoples lives worse off and it would make families get into debt or worse.

Haydn's Law – All children 16 and under to wear a helmet when riding a bicycle, To pass a law that all children aged 16 and under must wear a cycle helmet when riding a bicycle, The roads are not what they used to be, firstly they are much busier, where there used to be one car per family there are now 2,3 4 or more, many of these cars are 4x4 or SUV. There are many more accidents on the roads causing severe brain injury or even worse. As parents and adults it is our duty to protect our children as much as we possibly can. Research has shown that it is safer for children to wear helmets but they often refuse to wear one. This law would ensure all children would wear a helmet.

Make nurseries exempt from business rates to support the childcare sector, After owning nurseries for 29 years I have never experienced such damaging times for the sector with rising costs not being met by the funding rates available. Business Rates are a large drain on the sector and can mean the difference between nurseries being able to stay open and having to close., Early years education has endured more than enough hardship, closures, job losses by the government letting us down by not supporting the industry in the way it should be. The Government is putting money into early years through funded hours – which doesn’t cover costs – but then takes this back through business rates. This system needs changing. Private and voluntary run nurseries are being slaughtered. It’s enough now.

Review how Social Services operate and bring in procedures to protect parents, The Government should review Social Services with a view to abolishing the use of the term "at risk of possible future harm/neglect" and review all cases that have had children removed on this basis. , It should also make recording equipment mandatory for social workers and ensure Local Authorities use the same computer system. 

The term "at risk of possible future harm/neglect" is a contradiction within itself. With the correct support, there is no need to remove children from their birth families. 
 
Hand written notes are not reliable. Parents should be provided with a recorded copy immediately after any contact. 
 
Information sharing between departments needs to be simpler and quicker. Delays are causing too many problems in cases.

Add Environmental Conservation to the national curriculum for all schools, The Government should act to enhance the national curriculum at all stages in schools to include rigorous instruction in environmental and ecological conservation and sciences. Ensure these are promoted with at least equal weight to that afforded to matters such as economic and financial activity., After the declaration of Climate Emergency on 1 May 2019 by the House of Commons, there remains a lack of understanding among decision makers and the general public about the importance of these issues. There is a misplaced notion that environmentalism is either optional or a hindrance in the face of economic activity and development. For the undertakings made by the Government to be meaningful then these misconceptions in society must be changed on a fundamental level and from the youngest age.

Repeal the Fixed Term Parliaments Act., Repeal the Fixed Term Parliaments Act so that the government has the authority to unilaterally call for an early general election., Last year saw Parliament paralyzed as MPs refused to allow the government to carry out our departure from the EU by blocking every effort made to pass a Bill. The Fixed Term Parliament Act meant that the Parliament can intentionally leave itself in a stalemate and prevent a deadlock being broken by an early election. This Act is not fit for purpose and was last tried during the Long Parliament of 1640 which also ended in turmoil. This situation should not be allowed to occur for a third time.

Fund the creation of a new hospital between Shrewsbury and Telford, This petition calls on the Government to provide funding and the go-ahead for the building of a new hospital off the M54 motorway between Shrewsbury and Telford capable of providing accident and emergency services for the entirety of Shropshire and mid Wales., The 'Future Fit' hospital reconfiguration project has proved controversial and has been inundated with challenge. There have been reports of a leaked document revealing that the initial estimated cost of £312m for the reconfiguration has risen to £498m.
 
An end is nowhere to be seen; meanwhile there is growing tension and unease between neighbouring communities and A&E services in Shropshire are at breaking point. This solution is ideal, making sense geographically and will put an end to uncertainty.

Raise national speed limit to 80 mph on motorways and dual carriageways, I want the speed limit to raise to 80 mph on the specified types of roads mentioned, because this will improve road safety, because at the moment there are too many people tailgating each other so therefore raising the speed limit could make people drive more smoothly with less tailgating., This could raise the UK productivity as people can go to destinations quicker and therefore reducing the risk of an accident. There is alot of tailgating caused by slow moving vehicles raising peoples stress levels and increasing the risk of an accident  which is why there are more road deaths which some could have been better prevented. This is a fast moving environment with days getting more busy so the speed limit needs to be raised to meet the demands of ever fast changing world we live in.

Make it mandatory for Police & CPS to provide counselling to ALL victims of CSA, To ensure the Police and Crown Prosecution Service provide all victims of child sexual abuse with counselling & support before during & after trial. This is in gov legislation but the CPS & Police still advise victims to the contrary in order to avoid contamination of evidence. This needs to end., There is a moral duty and obligation for cps and police to provide counselling to victims and protect their rights to do so without fear their actions may affect their trial or the outcome of it.
 
My brother Declan was raped by an adult man as a minor by a (later convicted) paedophile. Before the trial my mum begged CPS, Police & Local Authority to provide support for her children who were traumatised but she was advised this would compromise the trial via contamination of court evidence. Despite her repeated cries for help my brother took his own life aged 13. His death could have been prevented & this still happens now. "Declan's Law" would ensure future CSA victims get the support they deserve

Abolish (or raise threshold on) luxury car tax for Ultra Low Emission Vehicles, Cars valued at or exceeding £40,000 are subject to the Luxury Car Tax (£1600 over 5 years). This should be abolished, or have the threshold raised significantly, for Ultra Low Emission Vehicles (ULEVs) as it impedes numerous Government initiatives and targets for transport and emissions., The tax contradicts the Government policies on reducing emissions, improving air quality, and rolling out ULEVs. Many comparative ULEVs which are suitable as replacements for petrol/diesel cars are higher priced by virtue of the advanced technologies and manufacturing processes required, and therefore are still more costly to produce. It is counter productive to offer grants for purchasing the vehicles and then tax consumers for running these vehicles, which help tackle the climate emergency.

Please allow veterinarians to use emergency lights when attending emergencies, I want the government to pass a law that allows veterinarians called to an emergency to use a Siren/ blue flashing light similar to the emergency services so they can reach the animal in distress more quickly., Having personally witnessed and experienced the death of a beloved horse due to the delay in a veterinarian getting to the emergency I feel they like all other emergency services should be able to use emergency lights / sirens to allow them quickly access to the animal in distress.

Abolish the House of Lords, The outdated House of Lords is unelected so should have no rights to stop what an elected government has been mandated to do., Abolish the unelected House of Lords which costs hard working tax payers too much money.

Make The Masters and The Open golf tournaments Category A free-to-air, For many years golf fans have enjoyed watching the greatest golf events on the planet live on the BBC - these include The Masters and The Open - for the first time in 2020 there will be no live coverage of Major golf events on free-to-air television. The sport could lose generations of supporters., Putting live golf coverage behind a paywall means that the sport is being lost to those that cannot afford to pay for a subscription. While it also fails to capitalise on the huge numbers of people who enjoy the game. 
 
Martin Slumbers, the Chief Exec of the R&A, recently stated that 10.2 million people played golf each year in the UK. The loss of live coverage of these Majors, and the inspiration that it gave to those that watched, means that golf will forever lose generations of future stars.

Revoke IR35 Legislation that is causing significant damage to UK businesses, Revoke IR35 legislation elements that put financial disadvantages on independent consultants when they want to be flexible and invest in the provision of services. The legislation currently creates the worst of all worlds with contractors inside IR35 worse off than permanent employees., Putting independent consultants at a financial disadvantage is resulting in the best ones leaving organisations and causing significant damage to projects.
Experienced consultants are often parachuted into more junior roles to provide the experience to get the job done. If they end up being paid the same as far less experienced staff they wont take up the roles in the first place and companies will suffer and damage the UK economy.

Require working from home if can work remotely during COVID-19 period, Coronavirus has been spreading in the UK with evidence of community infection. To delay the massive infection, government could ask people who can do the job remotely to work from home as early as possible. It could start from the technology companies in the big cities such as London and Birmingham., The lessons from China, South Korea, Italy and even Germany as well as France suggested a reactive approach will not work and a proactive approach is needed. Given all of the facts and examples in other countries, reducing the public crowd such as public transport is one of the most effective ways. So requiring people to work from home could help delay the major breakout. Technology companies in the big cities will be the best ones at the first stage.

Continue the Red Diesel Exemption Status for Legitimate UK Industry & Business., To keep the long held exemption currently in place, that allows business in many sectors in the UK to continue to operate using Red Diesel at a reduced duty rate., With so many UK businesses reliant on the reduced duty rate from sectors including Showmen and Circuses, Construction, Fisheries,  Heavy Plant & Transport etc and also second tier operators such as back up generation of power for Communications, Hospitals and mass event organisations incorporating public safety, this petition asks that the provision of the reduced duty rate is retained as the immediate downturn effect on commerce could severely outway any possible added benefit to the Treasury Department or the UK economy as a whole.  The importance of the 'lifeblood' of these industries at an affordable rate cannot and should not be underestimated.

Fund more support for mental health., I want more funding for services to provide more support to families that deal with mental health. This needs to be spent on more places to access, and more things to do such as activities and social group days for people to help them understand life and life skills. Also more acceptance in schools., People seek help from local authorities for years and receive diagnosis but with absolutely no support. I know many people are taking their lives and lashing out in other ways because they’re at war with themselves each day. There is no support given. I feel that this is a major issue that is not addressed. People don’t ask for these disabilities, but because it’s not physical it’s the most unaccepted.

Negotiate full membership of the future Erasmus+ education and youth programme, Erasmus+ is the European Union programme for education, training, youth and sport. We want the government to negotiate full membership of the future Erasmus+ programme, which will run from 2021-27, as part of any future relationship with the European Union., Through Erasmus+ young people can study, volunteer and gain work experience abroad, to develop new skills, gain vital international experience and boost their employability. Currently around 28,000 young people in the UK go abroad through the Erasmus+ programme each year and Erasmus+ students coming to the UK generate £420 million to the UK economy. The programme also allows staff to teach or train abroad and UK organisations to collaborate with international partners.

Keep the UK's membership of the EU Convention on Human Rights, We should remain within the ECHR to protect our legal rights., Leaving the EU Convention on Human Rights means the UK population could be open to threats of a return to the death penalty, torture, no right to assembly, and could lose many acquired rights such as paid maternity/paternity leave, paid holiday leave, maximum working hours, union membership, appeal against unfair dismissal, and many others.

Move the capital of the UK., Remove the capital city status from the city of London and confer it to another existing city, town, village or structure somewhere else in the United Kingdom., Now that Brexit is done, there is no need to position the UK capital so close to Europe as we are no longer seeking diplomatic or trade relations with Europe. With this in mind, why not move the capital city somewhere else in the United Kingdom to better serve our current needs?

Abolish the mandatory 0.7% GDP Foreign Aid target and spend our money at home, We believe it is time our Government got its priorities right and abolished the mandatory Foreign Aid budget target.
When we have homeless veterans sleeping on our streets, flooding in our towns and villages, it is wrong to spend over £14bn a year on Foreign Aid, We call upon the Government to abolish the mandatory 0.7% GDP target and focus its priorities on defence, armed forces, homeless veterans and flood defences.

All drivers to take a refresher course every 10 years., Create a law that states every driver on the road must sit a competency test, (practical and theory) every 10 years. With a Green, Amber, Red scoring system. Green - Pass. Amber - Pass but must have some retraining. Fail - Must retrain and retest, can no longer drive on their current license., The roads are changing, the laws are changing yet no one is retrained to drive on our roads. Dangerous drivers will be removed from the roads making our roads much safer and CO2 emissions could be hugely reduced with less vehicles on the road. Safer roads means less incidents caused, which in turn creates a safer environment for everyone. The rates of car insurance could be significantly reduced as the risk of collision/injury will be cut.

Ban parking charges in motorway rest areas/service stations, Ban parking charges in motorway rest areas/service stations for stays of under 12 hours so that tired drivers are encouraged to stop and recuperate, for free, before continuing their journey (as is common practice in other developed countries such as France).
Tiredness kills, as does profiteering., From the Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents:

"...research shows that driver fatigue may be a contributory factor in up to 20% of road accidents, and up to one quarter of fatal and serious accidents.

These types of crashes are about 50% more likely to result in death or serious injury as they tend to be high speed impacts because a driver who has fallen asleep cannot brake or swerve to avoid or reduce the impact."

https://www.rospa.com/Road-Safety/Advice/Drivers/driver-health

Allow Paracetamol to be sold in pack sizes of 100-250 again, Consider the benefits of having a workable supply of tablets being available in shops or chemists in a single pack. , Currently we needed to stockpile 6 packs of 16 tablets to have enough to last just one person long enough to get through 14 days, the length of time days people with Covid19 are required to self-isolate.

The 1998 research that reduced the supply of these tablets was well meaning. In reality, anyone who wants to overdose on Paracetamol can find a way to access it. But when you have Covid19 and suffer the associated flu symptoms like muscle pain, high temperatures and fever, a pack size of 16 tablets lasts one person 48 hours and self isolation makes replenishing supplies extremely difficult. Chemists can sell packs of 32 but most people shop in shops and can only buy packs of 16.

Turn lights back on at night time in Lincolnshire, To get the lights turned back on at night time, As crime is on the rise, elderly people won’t come out at night time because the lights being switched off, partially sighted people can’t come out at night time because the roads & Pavements are in such a bad state., We’ve been told by Lincolnshire County Council that for this to happen it will cost Skegness Town Council 500k over 20 years, however for this to happen, it has to paid in a one off payment and not in instalments and will not guarantee how long the light will be switched back on for, even though they want the full amount up front.
Get accident prevention actions on A41 Berkhamsted and Tring Bypass, Accident prevention,speed reductions at junctions,speed signag and accident information,

Allow 'Personal Electric Vehicles' to use cycle lanes and walkways., Allow the responsible use of personally owned electric vehicles with speed / power restrictions on cycle lanes and walkways. I would like to see similar access to that which is allowed mobility scooters on public walkways and cycle lanes. Is a mobility aid for the able too much to ask?, Given the global uptake on the use of personal electric vehicles such as scooters, unicycles, onewheels and the numerous segway type devices I believe it is something inevitable and needs legalisation. There are numerous stories of people replacing their polluting car journeys with the greener, healthier, outdoor option of the personal electric vehicle and often completing their journey in half the time travelling at half the speed. I myself have been a lot more active since owning a PEV.

Keep the hard shoulder on Smart Motorways for emergency use only, Stop the use of hard shoulders as live lanes on smart motorways, Using the hard shoulder of a Smart Motorway as a live lane puts road users at risk.
It gives stranded motorists no safe place to stop and prevents emergency services from reaching accidents.
Consider the risks presented by using a hard shoulder as a live lane against the significant risks.

Prevent the use of driving aids during driving tests. , The driving test has become too easy and the cars people take the test in do not reflect the cars thy can afford to buy after. , Currently you can take your test in cars with parking sensors/cameras, hill start assist and cruise control but most new drivers buy cars without this.

Ban the use of driver aids on test along with bringing back more difficult manoeuvres like turn in the road and reversing around a corner to help to reduce the number of incidents.

3 penalty points and £100 fine for not using indicators on the road., Introduce 3 penalty points on driving license and £100 fine for not using the indicators on the road., Everytime people don't use indicators it causes danger on the road, slows the traffic down and causes accidents. 21st century and people don't use them when changing the lane on the motorways, making u-turns or when exiting roundabouts causing many unsafe situations or even accidents on the roads and slowing the traffic down especially on the roundabouts.

Put a zebra crossing out side Ilminster School bristol
The roads are dangerous, I think a lot of parents should precipitate this and keep the child safe going to school something needs sorting, Put traffic lights up or a zebra crossing
We had a volunteer lollipop lady but she's become unwell
I think something needs to be done 
And keep are childen safe

Run a Public Awareness Campaign about the Climate and Ecological Emergency, We need the government to run a ‘Climate and Ecological Awareness’ public information campaign that will reach as wide an audience as possible.  The government has carried out such campaigns in the past for issues that posed far less danger to our well-being, for example the anti-smoking campaign., The UK Committee on Climate Change is telling us that we are not currently on track for our 2050 net-zero target and we are likely to see global warming of 2-4 degrees by the end of this century. This is far higher than the levels deemed ‘safe’ in the IPCC special report of 2018.   Many of us are oblivious to the damage that we wreak daily on our environment by our activities.

We all need to get involved in facing the challenge, so that the UK can be a role-model for the rest of the world.

Immediate stringent measures for COVID-19 containment. 
Stop wasting time., 1) Compulsory working from home when possible - especially in London
2) Compulsory cancellation of all not urgent meetings / conferences / events 
3) Encourage people to stay at home
4) More transparent daily updates at a set time with press conference - stop the actual 24hrs delay, The UK Governement is wasting precious time to contain the COVID-19 outbreak. 
Data clearly show that the only way to stop the chain of infection is encouraging the population to self-isolate as much as possible. 
The NHS has about half the number of doctors per population and much less ITU beds than Italy - do we really want to wait and see? 
We need urgent measures now - the solution is in our hand if we want to grasp it.

Make it illegal for politicians to lie to the public!, Every single time there is an Election or a referendum politicians tell a whole load of lies. And also come on TV and do interviews telling lies.

 

People are sick and tired of politicians lying so act now!!!!!!,

Increase funding to help with the mental health system, A lot more money needs to be invested into the mental health system & it needs to be treated as the serious issue that it is. There needs to be a new support system put in place that will work for the people in crisis & their families. This has to be seen as a priority, more needs to be done & fast., Mental health has become a huge crisis & there is not enough help or support out there for the people suffering, including the family it also effects. There is so much media attention now out there on this subject but depending on where you are in the country, it can be impossible to find any real help & people get lost circling the sytem, being passed from pillar to post, we can see this having a detrimental knock on effect to those around the person in crisis. This needs to be addressed

Give local residents right to object to HMO licence applications., Currently there are no legal Powers to allow permanent residents to request that a property is forbidden from having an HMO licence within a district. Some towns and Cities have areas with very high HMO concentrations vs. permanent residents which adversely affects the local community spirit., I've witnessed the growth of the two local Universities from having a combined enrolment below 10,000 students to more than 26,000 in 25 years. This expansion has only been possible due to a large number of private homes being brought and rented as HMO's. The situation has devastated local communities with high HMO concentrations within certain districts. This issue is mirrored across the Nation in Towns & Cities as the Universities have expanded unchecked year on year.

Dissolve the house of lords, More than £1 million was claimed by 110 peers in the House of Lords who failed to make a single spoken or written contribution in the upper chamber of parliament, Take the monies back. sack them!, The are a leech on the public taxes whilst sleeping in the- chambers

Require UK election results to be counted and reported at polling district level, Currently, election results are reported at different levels of granularity, depending upon election type and decisions made by local  EROs, and no lower than ward level. All elections – national, regional and local, including referendums – should be counted and reported at polling district level., Politics in the UK is increasingly complicated. Counting and reporting all election results at the more granular, polling district level will help policy-makers determine what issues are of importance to different parts of the electorate and improve the policy-making process, whilst maintaining voter anonymity. EROs should be required to count elections at polling district level, and the results made public on a national website.

Protect the childcare element of Universal Credit from deductions, Deductions from the childcare element of Universal Credit need to stop., By applying the deductions resulting from earnings to the childcare element, single parents who have no choice other than to use childcare can be left financially worse off for working. Childcare is a set cost that many parents have to pay to enable them to work, and parents should not be penalised for this.

Make electric scooters legal to reduce our carbon footprint / cut emissions, Make electric scooters legal, by doing this we will make people’s commute easier and reduce the carbon footprint. This is a big issue and something has to be done. They are similar to bikes: they are easy to control and compact so can be picked up and carried.,

Limit yearly council tax increases to level of inflation, Many local authorities are increasing their levels of council tax at unprecedented rates. 116 out of 151 councils have increased the council tax bill to the maximum 3.99%, outstripping the rise in inflation., This has put enormous strain on normal families to cover the rise. Thus, council tax should not be allowed to rise more than inflation.

Close All Education Centres, Work Places and Ban Large Gatherings, Immediately., Stop the spread of Covid-19, act while the UK numbers are in their hundreds., This needs to be done immediately to safeguard the UK population. It's recommended action from experts world wide.

Create an earned amnesty route for migrants without leave to remain, Create an organised and earned scheme for migrants in the UK without leave to remain to earn amnesty and secure leave to remain to enable them to live with dignity and contribute to the UK's economy. 
, The scheme should be open to all who have not broken the law and have resided in the UK for over 12 years.

The immigration system does not meet the needs of many, there are concerns that the new Points Based System will not improve things, and a risk that there will be a skills shortage when the UK leaves the EU.

The current Prime Minister has expressed support for a proposal along these lines. The scheme could be run along the lines of how the Home Office processed legacy cases  between 2006 and 2011, so there is a precedent for it. It could alleviate great hardship to the most vulnerable and exploited in society.

Give UK nurseries emergency funding if they have to close down amid COVID-19, If nurseries are shut down in view of Covid-19, the Government should set up an emergency fund to ensure their survival and ensure that parents are not charged the full fee by the nurseries to keep children's places., Being without childcare and having to pay nursery fees is a great concern for parents with small children. Nursery-based care is already extremely expensive, especially for children up to the age of 3. To expect parents to pay these fees up front to keep a place at the time when there is no accessible childcare (and for many parents no paid work), is unrealistic. We also need these nurseries to survive. When this is over, parents want their children to return to their nurseries.

Allow each child to have 5 days of permitted school vacation during term time, Permitted absence from school without the fear of prosecution or fine for up to 5 days per child a year., If this was allowed it would be beneficial to the childrens wellbeing. I would also make it more affordable for families to book holidays off peak.

Encourage train companies to refund unused pre-booked train tickets, The Government should encourage train operating companies to provide refunds for all pre-booked but unused tickets during the Covid-19 crisis, regardless of ticket category (eg the normally non-refundable Advance tickets)., The advice to reduce unnecessary travel & cancellation of many events means that many people will not use their train tickets. Many categories of pre-booked tickets, eg "Advance" tickets are not normally refundable & only a partial refund is available if you are able to re-book for a later date.
 
Some people with such tickets might choose to travel just so as not to lose the money. In the interests of discouraging people from unnecessary train travel, full refunds should be provided.

Allow "Personal Electric Vehicles" to use cycle lanes and roads in the UK, Allow the use of personal electric micro mobility vehicles on cycle lanes and roads in the uk, Climate change is real and micro mobility will help cut co2 emissions, relieve congestion in major cities and towns and also reduce the number of road accidents from cars and other combustion engine vehicles. 1 extra person using a micro mobility device= 1 less person driving a car! 2020 needs to be the year for Zero emissions!

Provide clarity on how exams will be affected by the coronavirus for A levels., Help make it clear to A level students going to University this September how the ever growing threat of coronavirus will affect them and their peers, what measures will be put in place to ensure no student is put at a loss.,

To install speed calming measures around the Sparrows Lane area of New Eltham, I would like the government to install speed humps or other techniques of slowing down cars around the Sparrows Lane area of New Eltham so the risk of harm to people and animals can be minimised., I would like there to be speed humps because sadly last year my cat was hit by a speeding car causing her to be put down. I can not imagine if this was a child.  The amount of distraught there would be to the family would be tremendous.

There should be speed humps because there is 2 local nurseries and an entrance to Avery Hill Park. There is also Charlton Athletic Training Ground and all this means lots of cars some speeding.  This is one of the busiest roads in New Eltham without speed bumps.

To establish an emergency public relief fund for every citizen in the UK?, The public need to prepare properly for the outbreak. Millions of citizens have no liquidity or access to cash and will be unable to navigate through the coming weeks.
